Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4649951. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then join assays on assay_id and filter by assay chembl_id. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to enforce structure presence. Filter to rows where standard_value is not null and standard_relation equals '='. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not deduplicate. Sort the result by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
